definitions.gloss: chain, chain reaction, series of linked events
definitions.explanation: A sequence of events or phenomena where each one causes or triggers the next, forming a connected chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪循環|あくじゅんかん}→悪循環：12668_akujunkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧。
examples.english: To break the chain of a vicious cycle.

examples.japanese: ひとつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連鎖|れんさ}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧。
examples.english: One accident triggered a chain reaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{対話|たいわ}→対話：12400_taiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Dialogue is needed to stop the chain of violence.

notes:
FORMS:
{連|れん} (connect, link) + {鎖|さ} (chain) = linked chain.

COMPOUNDS:
- {連鎖|れんさ}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: chain reaction
- {連鎖|れんさ}⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧: chain of bankruptcies (domino effect)
- {食物|しょくもつ}{連鎖|れんさ}: food chain
- ⟦{負|ふ}→負：09512_fu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連鎖|れんさ}: negative chain, downward spiral

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧: to break the chain
- {連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧: to trigger a chain reaction
- {連鎖|れんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the chain continues

USAGE:
{連鎖|れんさ} often appears in contexts describing negative cascading effects (⟦{負|ふ}→負：09512_fu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連鎖|れんさ}), but can also be neutral (as in {食物|しょくもつ}{連鎖|れんさ}, food chain).
